integrity: The proof is deductive from the quadratic-space weight decomposition plus Corollary 2.7 and Theorem 3.12 of arXiv:2503.19663v1. No finite experiment is used as proof. The initiating source is cited where its blanket smoothness assertion is corrected.
scientific_limitations: The statement is restricted to the criticality-two action on \(B_5(2)\). It identifies the boundary image and the off-diagonal reducible cycles but does not identify the whole Chow quotient as a blow-up or determine every scheme-theoretic diagonal fiber.
title: Orthogonality is the missing boundary in the \(B_5(2)\) Chow-quotient example
